name: Кому уходит фрагмент
_: Every step checks one decision of the bridge. The texts are taken from the live recordings in tools/audiolab/takes, which travel with the module - the same phrases that were spoken into the microphone. They stay in Russian on purpose: they are speech, not interface, and they are the only cover the Cyrillic case folding in core/Text has.

steps._: A tie of one kind: doors and guard declared the same phrase. The argument is about whose command it is, not about what was said.
Only doors knows the phrase - there is no rivalry.
Expensive and greedy, in combat. The threshold of the expensive class is higher than that of the reversible one.
The same command, said indistinctly. There is not enough confidence for the expensive class - and the spell does not go off.

A command as the beginning of a longer phrase, SAID WITHOUT A BREAK. There is no boundary here and there must not be one: there was no pause in the speech and the engine handed over a single piece. The real danger of a prefix lives not here but where there is a pause - the recording prefix-pause checks that.
Greedy against sharing on one phrase with equal confidence. The cost is the same for both - reversible - so the outcome is decided by greed alone.
Expensive but not greedy: the high threshold is there, the exclusivity is not.
An English command next to Russian vocabularies. The bridge measures them by one yardstick and does not ask about the language.
A vocabulary that overlaps itself: one phrase is contained whole inside a longer one. The confidence is high and the margin almost nil - the margin threshold works.
A wide vocabulary of twenty similar phrases: the best and the second differ by a hair.
The command is mentioned, not given. Nobody is to do anything.
steps.text: я закрыл дверь как ты просил

steps._: The dialogue window is open, and TWO declared the same word. Their confidence is always equal - a vocabulary entry gives one and the same number. Only the order from the settings can separate them; on the built-in settings the order is empty and they share.
The dialogue window is open: the topic cuts off everybody except the subscribers of dialogue.
The same word outside dialogue. The subscriber of dialogue does not get it at all.
Said into a channel. A channel is chosen before every other topic - even before combat.
The same word without a channel: it does not reach the subscriber of the channel.
Silence: nothing was recognised. The auction has nothing to play out.
